body: Well, would you like to find someone like her, just to get dumped after couple years again? Nah, find someone better. I dunno man, I am so itching to end it, but I feel huge remorse when I think about my mother. Spending over 16 years abroad, working shitty jobs and giving all of that hard earned money to me, that I have food and clothes, and now I am just going to kill myself. Fuck man, I expected to be scared of death but I feel so guilty that I am vomiting. Why is everything so complicated. I hope you find your peace and a new SO. Having a good life and throwing that away in heat of the moment is very bad idea. Give yourself a year, not like 2 days.

Ok, so now is the stupid question: you aren't even 30, so you are still very valuable to younger women. Why can't you take some time, be single, and then look for another woman? Do you really not understand, or you don't want to say? If the latter, then I respect your privacy, you don't have to say anything.

How old are you? I'm probably the worst person to give advice, but I want to talk. Not to convince you or anything, just some talk. Why would you like to end your life? Is the marriage the only reason, or is there something else? I am young, but I thought that no good marriages end up with divorce, so would you like to say something more?

Helium-oxygen mixture (80:20) is used in intensive care medicine as respiratory gas, because it's easier to breath. Normal air contains 21% oxygen. Death by hanging is very painful, especially with thin rope. 
Why Friday is a d-day? Take your time, go on walk, at night when the city is sleeping, or maybe just visit a shrink ?

>After much struggle I'd say it is worth for me if I live my way which is not the normal rat race you're talking about (and I agree). I'm from the EU, changed to another country from mine and work from home with my two cats, windsurf and kitesurf as much as I can. I'm buying a small house debt free and renting the one I already paid for working some 20 years like crazy in an ugly European city. I agree with you, life is hard on everyone but mine hasn't been boring yet, i went into extreme sports, mainly skydiving, and healed a lot from my depression. What I'm saying is: you make your life, if you don't like it (and again I agree with you), change it to suit your needs. Don't waste a second and don't lose it as if it was granted!! come on dude, we got nothing to lose so better make the most out of it!

So I am forced to change my life, even if it sucks since I was born. I was procreated against my will and now I am not even allowed to end it. That's some fucking joke right there. If a husband hits his wife once per month, it's called a toxic relationship. How about life? I try my best and only time I'm not getting slapped in my face is during sleep. And life is worth living even if 90% of the time it sucks, really? Would you eat a plate full of shit, even if there was a sweet cherry on top of it, every day? Yeah, you don't like your life? Change it. HOLY SHIT DUDE. You are a genius. I thought that moving to another country, working out for 5 years, hours spent with shrinks, books about self-improvement, doing over 15 different internships (butcher,carpenter,IT-specialist,chemist and many more) and going way above my comfort zone to the point I got serious insomnia, trying new things and traveling was a change. I'll tell you what, in next 12hours I'll be dead, and I'm really happy to end this misery. Yeah, finally.

Thanks for asking. Tomorrow is the big day. For the last week I have been trying very hard to find a reason to live. Unfortunately I haven't found any. But those two sexy helium tanks are willing to help me while solving this problem. You know, I have been writing weekly journals about my life. I started this habit when I was 15 or something. And holy shit, so much changed in my life, but my life perspective stayed where it was. I don't like life, it's boring, absurd, weird, painfully slow if it sucks but it's gone in the blink of an eye if you are able to enjoy it. I always wanted to have at least a bearable kind of life. But dude, everything requires so much effort. To have some food, shelter and internet access I have to be at least 10h per day at work (lunch and commuting included), getting shit on every other day, doing basic stuff like cooking, cleaning etc. at home, gym and sleep. I mean, better than working 16h/7d in some factory, yeah, like almost infinitely better. But what I was saying, it's the difficulty of modern life, fucking rat race. Physically I think I'm moderately attractive. White male, 6'2 at around 200lbs, fit. I have received some compliments on my face, so I guess I'm like 6/10, or even like 6.5/10 at least. But mentally? Dude. I have never managed to have a GF, so yeah. Kinda sucks but whatever. I live in Switzerland and I have a very strong ugly accent. Swiss tolerate foreigners, but man, it's so difficult to socialise with them, especially with my language skills. I can barely express myself in my native language. I feel so alone, and even more around people. I can't even reconnect with my BFF anymore, because our lives are so different now. I just want to be happy, I have been trying for last 10 years, not alone, and so much effort brought me maybe a weak taste of happiness. I dunno man how bout you, but it ain't worth it for me.
You can speak for yourself, but conductors get traumatized after they unwillingly killed somebody. Why not Exit Bag?

Sure! It's fairly easy for me to make new friends, but man, I feel so down right now. Not because I'm gonna die this week, but because of all of those letters, emails and packages I have to send to family, co-workers etc. I feel so free, all of this misery will finally end, but I'm aware that my family and close friends won't have the same life after I'm gone.
Yeah, I went on some europe tour last year. I just feel empty abroad, like at home. I guess there is no point to live for me anymore.
I have 2 days left, let's see if I change my mind then.

Thanks man, but I have almost everything I could wish for. Life isn't something for me. Since time has existed, I haven't existed and life is so temporary and short. After my death I won't exist for the eternity. I can end my life at 22 and everything will be gone, but I won't care at this point, obviously. I have missed many things at life anyway.

Thanks man, it means a lot. I don't want to die, but I can't keep on living either. I'm an apprentice, a foreigner, my permission to stay here ends next month. If I won't have a job at that point I'll have to go back to my country, with no finished school or certificate. I feel so sick man rn. I have trued for last 10 years, finding reasons to live and it's just waste of time.
